purpose: Explicitly trigger a Vercel production deployment for the Employee Directory portal invitation permission fix.
release_scope: Fix the Employee Directory portal invitation permission check so critical-risk manage_users capability is enforced using the valid approve access level. This removes the invalid critical access-level argument that could prevent the new invite UI build from reaching production. Includes Send invite, Resend invite, portal status and server-side Supabase Auth invitation flow already implemented on main.
verification: Source review confirms PermissionAccess supports none, view, edit and approve; critical is a risk classification rather than an access level. Both Employee Directory visibility and server action checks now require manage_users at approve level. Final Vercel Ready state and live authenticated smoke test remain required.
instructions: Update this file only after the user explicitly requests deployment.
